name: Point-Based Chunk Rendering
aliases: Hardware Accelerated Point Rendering with Distance Attenuation
Point-Based Chunk Rendering — GL_POINTS Chunk Draw, Vertex Point Rendering
definition: Each chunk is rendered as a collection of points using GL_POINTS, with vertex attributes for position, normal, and texture coordinates.
summary: Point-Based Chunk Rendering renders volumetric data as distance-scaled point primitives, enabling high-performance hardware acceleration by avoiding fixed-size cubes and manual point size calls.
